retained_boundaries: All gc_app* and gc_notifications dashboard staff/admin endpoints, authored_notification*, notification_service, announcement notification guards/status, mobile_push providers/tasks/credentials and receipt claims remain retained: dashboard-triggered notifications and outcomes use them.

group_capacity, mobile_group_capacity, group_app_availability, passenger_change_propagation, passenger_identity_reconciliation, passenger/session/phone authority, sync_journal and realtime_hints remain retained: dashboard group/passenger mutation bridges.
core/security/mobile_jwt remains retained because GC manager creation/access and gc_app facade call hash_mobile_lookup; shared mobile_push_crypto remains retained for dashboard push delivery.

core/security/mobile_offline_lease remains retained: browser attendance_runtime.sign_offline_manifest and attendance_runtime_dependencies.SignedOfflineManifest plus global settings validation use it. Its tests remain retained.

infrastructure/security/mobile_otp_rate_limiter remains retained: public_upload_otp_rate_limiter subclasses it, traveller request/reuse quota helpers and Fresh/passport contact issuance/global error middleware import it. Its tests remain retained.
presentation/dependencies/mobile_auth remains retained conservatively with mobile_ops until parent decides native-ingress versus shared-mutation adapter scope.
application/mobile/otp_provider and infrastructure/whatsapp/otp_provider remain retained: Fresh/public returning/contact verification uses the same outgoing OTP contract/provider.
infrastructure/mobile_realtime, application/mobile/realtime_authorization and presentation/api/v1/routes/realtime_socket_support remain retained: dashboard_realtime/main/health use them.

mobile_ops, mobile_ops_passenger_support, mobile_ops_notification_support and mobile_attendance_action_support are conservatively retained pending parent decision because their mutation/receipt/attendance bridges affect retained dashboard data. No whole mobile* prefix rule.

All shared current_details, draft_collection, application/infrastructure/travellers and published migrations/database model registries/settings/schema catalogs remain retained. Native API ingress exclusion does not remove underlying dashboard/public-upload owners.

My Photos shared service/storage/authorization, approved passenger QR issuer, rooming/documents/attendance engines and generic middleware/CI/OpenAPI contracts remain retained; only native viewer ingress is proposed.
limits: No native runtime/test deletion or source modification, provider/API calls, browser or broad verification.
Only physically completed files receive full review credit in a separate ledger; AST test candidates are not full-read or approved exclusion records.
Exact-runtime caller edges outside proposed native group are listed for parent refinement; no broad prefix allowance.
